Can I use Northern Slate indoors and outdoors? Yes, Northern Slate is suitable for both interior and exterior applications, making it a versatile choice for a wide range of projects. Travis Choate Project Coordinator Is Northern Slate easy to install? Yes, customers consistently describe Northern Slate as easy to cut and install using basic tools. Panels are lightweight and designed for straightforward installation. Zach Erhardt Manager What colors are in Northern Slate stone panels? Northern Slate features a blend of light gray tones with darker charcoal accents and subtle tan highlights. This combination creates a natural, balanced look that works across modern and traditional spaces. Alex Kalosky Project Coordinator What do I need to complete a Northern Slate project? Most projects use: - Panels - Inside and Outside Corners - Trim or Ledgers - Left / Right Finished Edges These components are designed to work together for a clean, finished look. Where does Northern Slate work best? Northern Slate is commonly used for: - Exterior accents and facades - Modern or transitional homes - Outdoor kitchens and living spaces - Interior feature walls and fireplaces Sean McNamara Project Coordinator Will Northern Slate look too dark or too light? Northern Slate offers a balanced mix of light and dark tones. The lighter grays keep it from feeling too heavy, while the charcoal accents add depth and contrast. Courtney Mintz Project Coordinator Does it really look like natural stone? Northern Slate is designed with realistic texture and color variation. Many customers mention that once installed, it closely resembles real slate or natural stone.
